gen-zen-dots-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Zen Dots spaces its techy, friendly letters with generous room all round. Their best shared quality is generosity: Zen Kaku Gothic New, a sans with open-mouthed curves and no hairlines, carries that spaciousness into text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Dots gives every letter plenty of room, a techy, friendly look that holds up at any weight. But Zen Maru Gothic, a sans-serif, wins on smooth reading, with bowls that never snag.
gen-archivo-black-fs-epilogue: Authoritative and urban, Archivo Black packs the middle of every line with weight. Epilogue goes the other way, with curvy, wire-like monoline letters and a tall-bodied lowercase, stubby at the ascender tips.
gen-archivo-black-general-sans: General Sans reads smoothly, its pen pressure steady from first letter to last. Archivo Black does the loud work, filling the line's middle with heavy, authoritative shapes, while the sans-serif body carries each bend without a snag.
gen-archivo-black-switzer: Heavy meets wiry: Archivo Black is dense and authoritative up top. Switzer, with tubular, wire-like letterforms, is the quiet partner, and that gap in heft is the pair's real draw.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-bhutuka-expanded-on: A generous entry into the e's eye gives Aaargh its strong, commanding voice. BhuTuka Expanded One slows everything to a leisurely, literary walk, so next to Aaargh it feels like a shout followed by an unhurried sentence.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-padyakke-expanded-o: Padyakke Expanded One reads slowly, each glyph a knot on a slack rope. Aaargh, strong and commanding, lets each e open generously with bowls and stems matched in weight, while the serif body stays wide and unhurried.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-domine: Big, open gaps between its letter pairs give Alien Encounters an otherworldly, technological look. But Domine, a refined serif with compact ascenders and finer crossbars, brings the dignity back down to earth.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-esteban: Alien Encounters spaces its tall letters far apart, like signals from elsewhere. Esteban, a serif, does the quiet work, its thin parts only slightly slimmer than the stems, like etched lines in glass.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-noto-seri: Spacey and strange, Alien Encounters throws big gaps between its tall letters. And Noto Serif Hentaigana, a traditional serif, brings visible stroke modulation and open jaws on every curve.
